name: How can I improve ventilation and prevent moisture issues in a remodeled bathroom?

mainEntity.name: How can I improve ventilation and prevent moisture issues in a remodeled bathroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: Improving ventilation requires sizing your exhaust fan to the room's square footage and ensuring it vents directly to the home's exterior rather than into an attic or soffit. Look for a fan rated for adequate cubic feet per minute (CFM) with a low sone rating for quiet operation. Installing a timer switch or humidity-sensing wall control ensures the fan runs long enough after showers to clear airborne moisture. In Colorado's dry climate, proper exterior ducting prevents trapped moisture from causing attic condensation during cold winter months.
acceptedAnswer.description: Install a properly sized CFM exhaust fan that vents directly outside, paired with a humidity-sensing switch to clear moisture automatically after showers.
